import glob,re
for f in sorted(glob.glob('/tmp/r29rev/*.py')):
    s=open(f).read()
    print('=====',f,len(s.splitlines()))
    for i,l in enumerate(s.splitlines()):
        if re.search(r'SRC|sha256|send-merge|send-c1b|e5dc8ef0|866637df|assert .*hex',l): print(i+1,l[:200])
